FX-SMEAR-001.says: The settings as they start: from 40, 50 to 60, 50, radius 70, wider than the drawing: the picture at 6.4, 5 drawn out 3.2 pixels to the right, everything right of it pushed along.

FX-SMEAR-002.says: From 25, 50 to 75, 50, radius 4: a band 4 pixels each side of the middle row dragged 8 pixels right, the stripes at 4, 5 drawn out along it, the top and bottom rows untouched.

FX-SMEAR-003.says: FX-SMEAR-002 at reach 200: dragged twice as far.

FX-SMEAR-004.says: FX-SMEAR-002 at reach -100: dragged 8 pixels left from 4, 5.

FX-SMEAR-005.says: FX-SMEAR-002 at reach 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SMEAR-007.says: From 50, 20 to 50, 80, radius 5: dragged down the middle column, the blue band pulled down.

FX-SMEAR-008.says: From and to both at 50, 50: no drag, the drawing untouched.

FX-SMEAR-009.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear, from 25, 50 to 75, 50: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-SMEAR-002.

FX-SMEAR-010.says: To keyed from 25, 50 at frame 0 to 75, 50 at frame 4, from 25, 50, radius 4: frame 0 no drag, frame 4 FX-SMEAR-002: the drag grows out.

FX-SMEAR-011.says: FX-SMEAR-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-SMEAR-012.says: Radius eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 1000 and is held there.

FX-SMEAR-013.says: From 25, 50 to 30, 50, reach 1000, radius 3: the 0.8 pixel step ten times over, 8 pixels, the same drag as FX-SMEAR-002 but narrower.

FX-SMEAR-014.says: Radius 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-015.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-016.says: Reach 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-017.says: Reach -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-018.says: From at 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-019.says: To at 50, -1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-020.says: Reach keyed to 2000 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
